title: The face check guards the faces' source record; one claim corrected
items: A correction to the note "Corrections to the one-face note; the face check sees small repaints". It said the check that guards the face library tries a case on itself for every comparison it makes. It did not: a reviewer loosened 28 more of its comparisons, one at a time, and 19 went unnoticed.
It now tries 120 cases on itself, up from 80, and each refusal it can give has a case that draws it.
The record of where each face came from is held to the copy written when the packs were read: a change made to it by hand is refused, and building the sheet again no longer accepts it.
